title: Amazon Prime Air maybe coming to a city near you
summary: Amazon (AMZN) is taking Prime Air to the next level. The tech and retail giant plans to expand its drone delivery service to nearly 500 U.S. cities and towns by the end of 2026, roughly a sixfold increase over its current footprint. Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley joins Market Domination to break down Amazon’s drone delivery ambitions and what customers can expect as Prime Air expands to tens of millions of people.

title: Why China’s Unitree IPO Surge Is Good News for Tesla
summary: If humanoid robots are the future, and they appear to be based on what investors are willing to pay, then Elon Musk faces a formidable Chinese rival. Figure AI, which posts videos of its robots working in factories, has been valued at almost $40 billion.
